data.body: The concurrency group is keyed by `github.sha`, but `LAYER_NAME` (`aws-durable-execution-sdk-java-otel-plugin`) is a single, fixed-name, multi-region AWS resource, not a per-commit one. A `workflow_dispatch` run from `main` racing a `release`-triggered run for a different tag (or two releases published close together) will have different `github.sha` values and therefore run concurrently, each independently executing `list-layer-versions` -> `publish-layer-version` -> `add-layer-version-permission` against the same layer name in every configured region at the same time. That is exactly the shared-resource race this repo already guards against elsewhere with a static concurrency group. Use a static group name (e.g. `lambda-layer-publish`) so all publish runs against this shared layer are fully serialized instead of keyed per commit.
